# @winterhuan/dsh-antfarm
English | 中文
## Summary
Run the original feature-development, bug-fix and security-audit teams in DSH. Each specialist keeps
its own identity, persona and workspace, while each attempt gets a fresh Session. Configure Agents,
start tasks and inspect step outputs, stories and native transcripts on the workflow board. Version
`0.3.3` targets DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` and preserves historical `0.2.0` runs for inspection.
## Use this package
### Install and develop
Use Node.js `^22.19 || >=24`, pnpm `11.7.0` and a DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` Web profile providing the native
`standard` Agent Preset and local `spawn` provider. The bundle adds five workflow tools, the `/antfa
rm` command, the Session sidebar and the workflow board. It registers no Antfarm role presets.
Install the immutable release tag into a Web profile:
If this profile has the unscoped `dsh-antfarm` package, remove that layer with `dsh plugin --profile
web remove dsh-antfarm` before installing the scoped release.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
For source development:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Build before linking this checkout into an isolated profile. Set an independent `DSH_HOME` and point
`workspace-controller.config.documentsDirectory` at a temporary directory before opening Web.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart the development service and hard-refresh Web after rebuilding. Remove the layer with `dsh pl
ugin --profile antfarm-dev remove @winterhuan/dsh-antfarm`. Daily profiles use the fixed remote rele
ase described in the repository handoff; source edits do not update them.
### Start and inspect
Open **Antfarm workflow board** on the left, select a root Session with a project cwd, then choose a
workflow and describe the task. The feature-development team appears by default; bug-fix and securi
ty-audit teams are also available. Review the team and click **Start run** without entering a comman
d or opening the right sidebar.
Expand an Agent to edit its name, model, timeout and persona files. Click **Validate and save** befo
re starting; new tasks use the saved configuration. An empty model inherits the workflow model or DS
H default. **Advanced configuration** contains the complete YAML, save location, copy and override-r
anced configuration** contains the complete YAML, save location, copy and override-removal controls.
You can also start from a root Session with a project cwd using the commands below. Coding teams use
Git and GitHub CLI through their original agent instructions; prepare the repository, dependencies
and credentials appropriate to the task. The selected workflow authorizes its declared PR actions.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The short form `/antfarm <task...>` uses `feature-dev` by default. The model has `antfarm_run`, `ant
farm_list`, `antfarm_status`, `antfarm_resume` and `antfarm_cancel`. Run/resume tools wait for the w
orkflow outcome unless `background: true`; commands and panel starts return an admission receipt. Al
l reads and controls check the original root Session owner.
The global board shows explicitly authorized Sessions and runs; its team and launch form remain avai
lable when there are no runs. You can also open **Antfarm** in the right sidebar to configure a team
, start a run and inspect its steps, outputs, stories, events and child Sessions. Lists use fifty-ro
w pages; visible views refresh, hidden views stop polling, and failed refreshes retain loaded conten
pages; visible views refresh, hidden views stop polling, and failed refreshes retain loaded content.
### Recovery and retained files
Workers must return an explicit `STATUS: done`, `STATUS: retry` or `STATUS: failed`. Successful repl
ies must contain the step’s `expects` text; missing status, malformed replies and execution failures
consume the existing retry budget. A story verifier’s `retry` repeats the current story; other step
s stop the run and retain feedback. Correct the problem before resuming that step; recovery does not
automatically return to another step. Recovery guidance, previous failure feedback and available bu
ild/test baselines enter subsequent attempt inputs.
Resume resets the failed step while retaining completed stories and consumed story retry counts, fol
lowing original Antfarm. There is no additional retry grant. An interrupted native attempt requires
transcript inspection and recovery guidance; the host refuses a second live executor and late result
s from cancelled attempts. Completed or cancelled runs cannot resume.

## Model Experience
### Workflow tools and child instructions
#### What the model sees
The root model receives five workflow control tools. Each child receives the selected original perso
na files, declared skill instructions, project path, resolved step input and prior original context.
It returns the requested `KEY: value` text. Children cannot start nested Antfarm teams. Run UI quer
ies do not enter model context.
## Known Limitations and Deferred Work
- Each Run executes serially. Stable agent identities permit one active attempt each; multiple runs

wait when they share an agent.
- Role policies restrict direct tools. Shell and skill access can sti

ll modify files; deployment permissions remain authoritative.
- Original text outputs and PR links r
emain worker reports. The Host does not independently approve GitHub reviews or attach candidate-bou

nd test evidence.
- Interrupted effects can repeat after explicit recovery. SQLite, fresh Sessions a

nd event logs do not guarantee exactly-once external actions.
- OpenClaw cron installation, dashboar
d processes and polling-model calls use native DSH equivalents. Default Headless lacks the required

preset composition; DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` has no TUI entry.
- PARITY separates local mechanism evidence f
rom real-model quality, platform and remote release verification.
